name: elapsed-since-resume
brief: Stop the lane rail's elapsed-time readout from counting time a Pod spent stopped. A new nullable lanes.resumed_at column (migration 7) is stamped by the store's setLaneStatus whenever a lane goes from a terminal status back to running; PodManager's Matriarch revive passes its own clock; the rail's elapsedMs counts from resumedAt ?? startedAt, so a resumed lane restarts from zero while a never-resumed lane keeps today's reading. startedAt is never restamped, Calf lanes are not revived, and migration 7 joins the frozen-migration tripwire. Four tasks: T1 store and every Lane literal, T2 PodManager, T4 tripwire, T3 rail and the required two-day e2e test.
